background: The Goldman Sachs Group is the holding company of the leading US investment bank, earning from advisory, trading and asset and wealth management, with a smaller lending and deposit franchise than the universal banks.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the group, A- on average with the weakest at BBB+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 27 Jan 2021. Liquidity is a strength, with LCR of 126% in the top quarter of US banks, and CET1 of 12.9% sits at the median, but leverage of 4.3% is in the bottom quarter. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has fallen 1.6 points, leverage 1.0 points and Tier 1 leverage 1.3 points (figures to 30 Jun 2026), so capital is the thing to watch.
